text: Breif Introduction HUST offers a variety of master's degree and certificate options for the biotechnology professional and individuals interested in pursuing a career in the biotech field. Combining graduate courses in life sciences with management and business courses, HUST Biotechnology Graduate Programs are ideal for individuals interested in pursuing management opportunities within the industry. Why Biotechnology The biotechnology sector continues to be one of the fastest growing economic sectors in China creating new opportunities within the four primary sub sectors: I. Agricultural feedstock and chemicals II. Drugs and pharmaceuticals III. Medical devices and equipment and research IV. Testing and medical laboratories
